ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (Salvo.cs:20-23) == cost 1 / ATTACK / RARE / ANY_ENEMY. Salvo has no Retain keyword of its OWN -- the Retain hover tip (Salvo.cs:16) advertises what RetainHandPower does to the whole hand -- and the sim correctly leaves `retain` False.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(12m, ValueProp.Move)` (Salvo.cs:18) == `_damage = 12`, powered on both sides. The RetainHandPower amount is the literal 1 in both.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches: attack FIRST (Salvo.cs:28-30), then `PowerCmd.Apply<RetainHandPower>(..., 1m, ...)` (31) == `PowerCmd.apply(..., RetainHandPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)` -- the same power card/equilibrium applies, so the two cards are consistent on both sides.
